info.name: qAcademy_java
info.description: qAcademy School Management System - full REST API coverage (Auth, Students, Courses, Enrollments) generated from the actual controllers/DTOs/validators in src/main/java/com/qacademy, mirroring the same scenarios the RestAssured suite in src/test covers. Run folder-by-folder top to bottom (Auth first) - later requests chain off variables earlier ones set (tokens, createdStudentId, createdCourseId, createdEnrollmentId, etc.).
